<!-- pr-reviewer: 2aafba7eb0098f9723846976a891807f80bcf002 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The change affects holder and shank collision checks, reach checks, verification, and the post gate.

- The new bands retain the stated shank below the holder foot. They include the holder radius above the foot.
- The tests check both legal cuts and real collisions that must block the post.
- The change preserves the enclosing cylinder for callers that cannot read bands.
- The decision record explains the safety bounds and the alternatives.

I reviewed the change against the current `upstream/main:AGENTS.md`. The local trial merge with main `e3ca44fa705d71438a8fd8a8efccbafcc2b6517f` was clean. Main was already an ancestor of this head.

All builds and tests ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2207`. No GitHub runner was used.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed:

| Suite | Passed |
|---|---:|
| tools lib | 88 |
| app lib | 350; 1 ignored |
| accessory_collisions | 2 |
| fixture_ux | 9 |
| self_centering_vise_tilted | 3 |
| thread_mill | 8 |
| tool_after_state | 5 |
| tool_body_beside_shank | 5 |
| tool_gate | 9 |
| tool_neck_laws | 4 |
| wire_contour | 8 |

Additional holder regression suites passed:

| Suite | Passed |
|---|---:|
| holder_library | 12 |
| machine_default_holder | 13 |
| mcp_verify | 3 |
| pocket3d_reach | 6 |
| tool_body_bands | 13 |
| tool_body_drill_probe | 5 |
| tool_body_judged | 8 |

`cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed with no warnings. `RUSTC_WRAPPER` was unset for this command.

I repeated two reported mutations in the local worktree:

1. I replaced `holder_profile.rs` with main's version. `a_band_touching_only_the_shank_top_does_not_widen_the_judged_shank` failed: `left: 60.0`, `right: 6.0`. It passed after restoration.
2. I replaced `operation/tool_gate.rs` with main's version. The T31 pocket reach test and verify/post test failed. After restoration, all five tests in `tool_body_beside_shank` passed.

The worktree has no source changes after restoration. No goldens changed. No UI files changed, so before/after screenshots are not required. No dependency, script, workflow, or build configuration changed.

Requested changes: none.

The full workspace, release gate, GUI, and ignored test lanes were not run.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
